thread:
Aisha (CSM): quick sync — Fircliff week0 dry-run finished a few mins ago. overall green on latency and throughput, but three small items for follow-up: firewall egress rule mismatch, KMS key policy needs a principal add, and audit log prefixes not flowing into their SIEM. low severity but blocking full cutover.

Tom (Solutions): saw the same on our side, firewall was allowing 52.11.0.0/24 but customer sent 52.11.0.0/22. i pushed a note to their net team.

Rico (Eng-Infra): pinging the exact SG we asked them to apply — here's our recommended outbound rule (applied as security-group egress):
```
Type: All TCP
Protocol: TCP
Port Range: 0-65535
Destination: 52.11.0.0/22
Description: Redwood egress (api.redwood.internal)
```
If they applied /24 we need them to widen to /22 or add both entries.

Julia (Fircliff): confirming, our infra team only added the /24 yesterday. i'll ask them to add the /22 and reply here once done.

Sam (SRE): audit log side — their SIEM endpoint accepted the TLS connection but only two of four prefixes are present. looks like our log router is tagging two prefixes with `customer-prod-logs` and the other two with `customer-internal`. need consistent prefixing for their SIEM ingestion rules.

Aisha (CSM): Julia, if you can get one engineer to re-run the smoke test after the SG change that would unblock cutover. also Julia noted KMS rotation timing — they want rotation on Friday, but our recommended MR window is Sat night. small mismatch.

Julia (Fircliff): rotation on Fri is policy at client. can you share the minimal KMS policy change you mentioned?

Rico (Eng-Infra): minimal add — allow Redwood-infra role to Encrypt/Decrypt for the customer key. snippet: 
```json
{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-infra"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Can you paste into their key policy and save; rotation should then be fine.

Julia (Fircliff): pasted and saving now. will confirm when rotation window is set.

Tom (Solutions): one more item — retention on audit logs. client regulatory require 90d. our default was 30d in the ingestion pipeline, so we need retention change or a short-term hold.

Aisha (CSM): flagged renewal risk: Julia said finance will reassess if cutover slips beyond 2 weeks (budget quarter). not a showstopper yet but marking as medium-term risk. we're capturing in the account renewal radar. :warning:

Sam (SRE): i've opened a ticket with infra to change retention to 90d and added a temporary snapshot policy for the next 21 days. ticket #CI-4829.

deploy-bot: Deployment dry-run report uploaded: https://deploys.redwood.internal/reports/5981234567 — artifacts: network-check.tar.gz, kms-policy.json, audit-sample.log

Aisha (CSM): action list from here — Rico: confirm SG change applied & verify smoke; Tom: confirm retention change on pipeline; Sam: follow SIEM ingestion and close ticket; Julia: confirm KMS rotation slot and finance check-in; i'll triage renewal risk and update AMs. please update statuses by EOD Thu. :thumbsup:

Tom (Solutions): will confirm retention today.

Rico (Eng-Infra): i'll run smoke after they push /22, ETA 2 hours.

Julia (Fircliff): rotation scheduled Fri 22:00 local. finance will wait one week post-cutover but asked us to keep them in the loop.

Aisha (CSM): perfect — closing loop here after confirmations. i added the renewal risk flag in the account tracker. thanks team. :eyes:
